feeds.title: Acupressure Works Blog
feeds.description: Meet Marc Coseo, an N.C.C.A.O.M licensed acupuncturist with over 30 years of experience dedicated to the art and science of acupuncture, acupressure, and traditional Chinese medicine. During his days as a professional tennis player, he sought a safer and more effective way to warm up his muscles and enhance flexibility before intense workouts or matches. This quest led him to develop his signature Acupressure Ball Techniques, proving to be a game-changer in the world of sports, wellness, and recuperation from modern-day aches and pains.
